name: iris-starter-kit
description: Simple open-source Electron starter for IRIS markerless mocap apps

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.preview: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
